cues: Because a crossover is more likely between genes that are far apart, the recombination frequency measures distance.
It is the recombinant offspring divided by the total, times a hundred.
Sturtevant, in nineteen thirteen, made one percent recombination equal one map unit, one centimorgan, and drew the first genetic map, showing that genes lie in a line.
